entries.title: Moon in Ashwini
entries.body: Ashwini (Mesha 0°–13°20′) is ruled by Ketu and presided over by the Ashwini Kumaras, the divine physicians. It gives quickness, initiative, healing ability and a youthful, adventurous spirit, and favours fresh starts. Haste is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Bharani
entries.body: Bharani (Mesha 13°20′–26°40′) is ruled by Venus under Yama, lord of restraint. It gives intensity, endurance, creative and sensual power, and the capacity to carry heavy responsibilities. Moral seriousness is its strength, and excess its caution.

entries.title: Moon in Krittika
entries.body: Krittika (Mesha 26°40′–Vrishabha 10°) is ruled by the Sun under Agni. It gives a sharp, discerning, purifying nature, courage and leadership, and a cutting honesty that can wound. It favours clarity and protection of others.

entries.title: Moon in Rohini
entries.body: Rohini (Vrishabha 10°–23°20′), ruled by the Moon under Brahma, is the Moon's favourite star. It gives beauty, charm, creativity, fertility and love of comfort and the arts, with growth and prosperity. Possessiveness is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Mrigashira
entries.body: Mrigashira (Vrishabha 23°20′–Mithuna 6°40′) is ruled by Mars under Soma. It gives a searching, curious and gentle mind that loves travel and research, and suits exploration and learning. Restlessness and indecision are the cautions.

entries.title: Moon in Ardra
entries.body: Ardra (Mithuna 6°40′–20°) is ruled by Rahu under Rudra, the storm. It gives intellectual intensity, emotional storms that clear the air, and skill in research and technology. Growth comes through upheaval and renewal.

entries.title: Moon in Punarvasu
entries.body: Punarvasu (Mithuna 20°–Karka 3°20′) is ruled by Jupiter under Aditi. It gives return and renewal, optimism, generosity, philosophical outlook and contentment with simple things. It favours recovery after setbacks.

entries.title: Moon in Pushya
entries.body: Pushya (Karka 3°20′–16°40′) is ruled by Saturn under Brihaspati. It is traditionally among the most auspicious nakshatras, giving nourishment, protection, devotion, discipline and a caring, dutiful nature. It suits teaching and counselling.

entries.title: Moon in Ashlesha
entries.body: Ashlesha (Karka 16°40′–30°) is ruled by Mercury under the Nagas. It gives penetrating insight, strategic intelligence, hypnotic persuasion and depth in psychology or medicine. Suspicion and manipulation are the shadow, and healing is its higher use.

entries.title: Moon in Magha
entries.body: Magha (Simha 0°–13°20′) is ruled by Ketu under the Pitris, the ancestors. It gives dignity, respect for lineage and tradition, leadership and a regal bearing. Pride and attachment to status are the cautions.

entries.title: Moon in Purva Phalguni
entries.body: Purva Phalguni (Simha 13°20′–26°40′) is ruled by Venus under Bhaga. It gives enjoyment, creativity, affection, generosity and talent in the arts, and favours relationships and celebration. Indulgence is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Uttara Phalguni
entries.body: Uttara Phalguni (Simha 26°40′–Kanya 10°) is ruled by the Sun under Aryaman. It gives loyalty, reliability, a sense of contract and duty, and helpful leadership. It favours partnerships and patronage.

entries.title: Moon in Hasta
entries.body: Hasta (Kanya 10°–23°20′) is ruled by the Moon under Savitar. It gives manual dexterity, wit, resourcefulness and skill in crafts and healing arts, and cleverness in trade. Restless cunning is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Chitra
entries.body: Chitra (Kanya 23°20′–Tula 6°40′) is ruled by Mars under Tvashtar, the divine architect. It gives artistry, design sense, charisma and love of beautiful things, and suits architecture and the arts. Vanity is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Swati
entries.body: Swati (Tula 6°40′–20°) is ruled by Rahu under Vayu, the wind. It gives independence, adaptability, diplomacy and business skill, bending but not breaking. It favours trade and self-directed paths. Scattered energy is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Vishakha
entries.body: Vishakha (Tula 20°–Vrishchika 3°20′) is ruled by Jupiter under Indra and Agni. It gives determination, focus on goals, ambition and eventual triumph. Single-mindedness can become impatience or jealousy.

entries.title: Moon in Anuradha
entries.body: Anuradha (Vrishchika 3°20′–16°40′) is ruled by Saturn under Mitra. It gives devotion, friendship, loyalty and success abroad or in organisations, and the ability to thrive in difficult conditions.

entries.title: Moon in Jyeshtha
entries.body: Jyeshtha (Vrishchika 16°40′–30°) is ruled by Mercury under Indra. It gives seniority, protective leadership, courage and resourcefulness, with a sense of responsibility for others. Pride and secrecy are the cautions.

entries.title: Moon in Mula
entries.body: Mula (Dhanu 0°–13°20′) is ruled by Ketu under Nirriti. It gives a drive to reach the root of things, philosophical inquiry and research. It can bring the uprooting of old structures that leads to truth.

entries.title: Moon in Purva Ashadha
entries.body: Purva Ashadha (Dhanu 13°20′–26°40′) is ruled by Venus under Apas, the waters. It gives invincibility of spirit, persuasion, pride and purification, and a strong sense of conviction. It favours inspiring others.

entries.title: Moon in Uttara Ashadha
entries.body: Uttara Ashadha (Dhanu 26°40′–Makara 10°) is ruled by the Sun under the Vishvadevas. It gives integrity, lasting victory, a sense of duty and leadership grounded in righteousness. Its success is slow but permanent.

entries.title: Moon in Shravana
entries.body: Shravana (Makara 10°–23°20′) is ruled by the Moon under Vishnu. It gives listening, learning, the preservation of knowledge, teaching, counselling and a good reputation, along with devotion and organisational skill.

entries.title: Moon in Dhanishtha
entries.body: Dhanishtha (Makara 23°20′–Kumbha 6°40′) is ruled by Mars under the Vasus. It gives wealth, rhythm and music, generosity, ambition and adaptability in groups. Its success is social.

entries.title: Moon in Shatabhisha
entries.body: Shatabhisha (Kumbha 6°40′–20°) is ruled by Rahu under Varuna. It gives healing, secrecy, independent and scientific thinking, and interest in medicine, astrology or technology. Solitude may be sought.

entries.title: Moon in Purva Bhadrapada
entries.body: Purva Bhadrapada (Kumbha 20°–Meena 3°20′) is ruled by Jupiter under Aja Ekapada. It gives intensity, idealism, austerity and a transformative, sometimes extreme, drive for spiritual or social causes.

entries.title: Moon in Uttara Bhadrapada
entries.body: Uttara Bhadrapada (Meena 3°20′–16°40′) is ruled by Saturn under Ahir Budhnya. It gives depth, wisdom, self-control, compassion and steady spiritual strength, and favours a stable, generous life.

entries.title: Moon in Revati
entries.body: Revati (Meena 16°40′–30°) is ruled by Mercury under Pushan, the nourisher and guide of travellers. It gives gentleness, compassion, protectiveness, artistic sensitivity and safe journeys. It completes the zodiac with a sense of fulfilment.
